faqs.q: What is PVC lay flat discharge hose used for?
faqs.a: PVC lay flat discharge hose is a light, economical hose for low-pressure water: irrigation, discharge from construction-site and trash pumps, pool and tank draining and other temporary transfer. It rolls flat for storage and transport.

faqs.q: What is PVC lay flat discharge hose made from?
faqs.a: The tube and cover are PVC with woven polyester reinforcement, and the colour is blue. It is odourless and light enough for one person to run out and roll up.

faqs.q: How do I choose the bore of PVC lay flat hose?
faqs.a: Pick the bore for the flow you need and the friction loss you can accept over the line length, then check that the working pressure covers the pump’s maximum plus surge. Send the flow, length and pump and we size it.

faqs.q: What pressure is PVC lay flat discharge hose rated for?
faqs.a: It is a low-pressure hose, and a per-size pressure table is not published. Tell us the bore, length and pump and we confirm the rating before quoting; burst pressure is a test figure, never an operating limit.

faqs.q: PVC, NBR or TPU lay flat hose: which should I choose?
faqs.a: PVC is the lightest and lowest-cost choice for clean, low-pressure water. NBR adds oil and abrasion resistance at 10 bar, and TPU gives the highest pressure and longest lengths. See the [TPU vs NBR vs PVC guide](/blog/tpu-vs-nbr-vs-pvc-lay-flat-hose) and our [NBR lay flat hoses](/c/nbr-lay-flat-hoses).

faqs.q: Is PVC lay flat hose suitable for oily water or abrasive ground?
faqs.a: No. Oily water, abrasive ground and higher pressure need the NBR or TPU lay flat hoses in this range. PVC is for clean water at low pressure on temporary or seasonal lines.

faqs.q: Can PVC lay flat hose be supplied with couplings fitted?
faqs.a: Yes. We cut to length and fit the couplings you specify (Bauer, camlock, Storz, grooved or flanged ends) secured with bands or expansion-ring fittings sized to the hose. See our [lay flat hose couplings](/c/lay-flat-hose-couplings).

faqs.q: How should PVC lay flat hose be stored?
faqs.a: Drain and flush it, roll it flat from the far end, and store the coil out of direct sunlight and away from sharp objects. Inspect the cover and coupling bands before each deployment; see the [lay flat hose in Gulf heat guide](/blog/lay-flat-hose-in-gulf-heat).

faqs.q: Where is PVC lay flat hose used?
faqs.a: It suits irrigation, construction-site pump discharge, pool and tank draining and other temporary low-pressure transfer. See the [irrigation lay flat hose guide](/blog/irrigation-lay-flat-hose-guide).

faqs.q: What lengths does PVC lay flat hose come in?
faqs.a: It is supplied in long continuous lengths or as made-up assemblies with couplings fitted. State the bore, the length you need and both end connections.

faqs.q: What do I send to order PVC lay flat hose?
faqs.a: Send the bore, the length, the fluid and the end connections, or the Indus part number. We confirm the rating before quoting; see our [lay flat hose guide](/blog/lay-flat-hose-guide) for sizing.

faqs.q: Do you stock PVC lay flat discharge hose in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep PVC lay flat discharge hose in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send bore and length through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
